Is there an MCP server for LinkedIn?

Mate, I just asked Perplexity about an MCP server for LinkedIn. MCP is usually Microsoft Communications Protocol, mostly for things like Skype or Teams, not LinkedIn. LinkedIn doesn’t officially run an MCP server as far as public info goes. It’s mostly a web and app platform, no public messaging server like that.
